content: driveItem content download (Microsoft Learn, updated 2025-08-27). GET .../items/{id}/content returns HTTP 302 Found with a Location header pointing at a preauthenticated download URL - the same value as the @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl property. Verbatim: 'Preauthenticated download URLs are valid for a limited time. Use them immediately, as they might expire within minutes. You don't need to include an Authorization header when you access the download URL.' Range requests must be sent to the @microsoft.graph.downloadUrl host, NOT to /content; a Range request returns 206 Partial Content, or 200 with the full file if the range cannot be served. Community reports put the practical validity around one hour but Microsoft does not document a duration and explicitly warns it may be minutes. Implication for long media playback: a downloadUrl resolved at play time can expire mid-stream, so the player must be able to re-resolve on a failed seek/reconnect.
